annotations.title: Record that a fix was applied

description: Records the date a finding's fix was made on the website (not in the future). Its effect is then measured 28, 56 and 90 days later. The finding and its evidence_id come from webops_finding; when the evidence has changed since, nothing is recorded and the answer says to read the finding again. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.
name: webops_mark_applied
title: Record that a fix was applied
